en.headline: Officials expect 1.29 million Golden Week visitors
en.dek: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said mainland arrivals over the National Day holiday are forecast to rise 5 per cent, after Mid-Autumn visitor numbers increased by more than 20 per cent.
body: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said about 1.29 million mainland visitors are expected in Hong Kong during the National Day Golden Week, about 5 per cent more than a year earlier.

Speaking on Wednesday as the seven-day holiday began, Law said some travellers had already come for Mid-Autumn Festival, when visitor numbers rose by about 20 per cent or more. She still described the Golden Week outlook as steady, pointing to the National Day fireworks, the extended lantern displays at Victoria Park and promotions by retailers.

She cited industry figures showing restaurant takings up 20 to 30 per cent over Mid-Autumn and said hotel occupancy during Golden Week is expected to reach 90 per cent or higher. Retailers have said they hope for sales growth but have also warned that cautious spending may limit gains across the wider trade.

Law said spending by visitors still has room to improve, while cultural goods, licensed products, concerts and large-event tickets have been selling more strongly. She pointed to merchandise tied to an Egyptian exhibition at the Hong Kong Palace Museum as an example of that shift.

zh.headline: 文體旅局料黃金周內地客129萬人次
zh.dek: 局長羅淑佩表示，國慶黃金周訪港內地旅客預計達129萬人次，按年升約5%；中秋訪港人次已升兩成或以上，酒店入住率料達九成或以上。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，國慶黃金周期間預計有約129萬人次內地旅客訪港，較去年同期上升約5%。
她周三正值七日假期展開時表示，部分旅客已於中秋節期間提早到港，當時訪港人次按年升約兩成或以上。她仍認為黃金周市道平穩，並提到國慶煙花、維園綵燈展期延長及零售商戶的推廣。
她引述業界數字指，中秋期間餐飲業營業額升兩成至三成，黃金周酒店入住率預計達九成或以上。零售業界期望生意有增長，同時亦有商會提醒消費審慎，整體升幅可能有限。
羅淑佩承認旅客消費仍有改善空間，但文化產品、授權商品、演唱會及大型活動門票銷情較佳。她以香港故宮文化博物館埃及展覽相關商品為例，說明這類消費的變化。
